title: About Imagine PPTP Prints
subtitle: A custom print shop at 840 N State St in Elgin, Illinois.

story.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Imagine PPTP Prints prints custom shirts, hoodies, hats, banners, business cards and stickers for businesses, teams, events and individuals. We work with customers in the Elgin area and ship nationwide.
We help with design at no extra charge, send a digital proof before anything is printed, and finish most orders 24–48 hours after you approve it.

what.title: We speak your language
what.body: Call, text or write to us in Spanish and we’ll handle your whole order in Spanish.

hours.title: Business hours
hours.delivery: Pickup in Elgin, local contactless delivery, and shipping nationwide.
